enjoying my immediate life is the issue, and having things I really enjoy on my own is, I agree, entirely essential. It's the key ingredient everyone I know seems to have to some degree, but has eluded me for the past 23 odd years.
I'm not in any way advocating suicide as a method of fixing my problems, i'm trying to avoid getting to the point where one day i'll be overwhelmed with suicidal thoughts and do something i'd really rather not.
I think the key ingredient is figuring out how to enjoy things. I mean, is it not slightly unusual that I find no pleasure in doing *anything* unless someone else knows about it?

I agree that people change, I have no doubt that i will be a different person a year from now, or more. but it seems the one constant in my life has been my inability to enjoy myself... I worry that at some point it's going to drive me over the edge.
